claim: CAS monitors thought patterns and drift to maintain self-awareness.
Capability readiness and trust dashboards drive escalation decisions.
CAS tracks activation levels to understand what's 'hot' vs 'cold' in AI attention.
CAS recognizes four specific cognitive error patterns: categorization error, activation gap, procedure gap, and self vs system blind spot.
CAS systematizes self-examination through hourly cognitive checks, post-operation analysis, error investigation, and continuous meta-learning.
CAS monitors cognitive load and detects when it exceeds healthy thresholds (typically 0.70-0.80).
CAS provides three core guarantees: transparent cognition, failure prevention, and self-improvement.
CAS integrates with all AIM-OS systems through cognitive observation hooks, including APOE, VIF, HHNI, CMC, SDF-CVF, and SEG.
